newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech nine-month order backlog up.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech nine-month order backlog up.

text.p: Austrian engineering group VA Technologie AG said on Friday that its order backlog increased in the third quarter and reiterated that it expected significant pre-tax earnings growth this year.
In a letter to shareholders VA Tech said that its order backlog at the end of September stood at 80 billion schillings, up from 71.68 billion at the end of the first half.
"For 1996 the board expects substantial, continuous growth in business volume and (pre-tax) profit which will make a shareholder friendly dividend policy possible," the firm said.
In 1995, VA Tech paid a 28 schillings dividend.
It repeated that net profit growth would be capped by higher taxes. The government has scrapped tax credits on losses carried forward for 1996 and 1997.
